answer: Delayed beacon admission lottery. Agents register each identity with a unique live endpoint and pay a nonrefundable 0.01 ETH epoch fee before cutoff. A public VRF beacon after cutoff selects the admitted subset, so attackers cannot precompute winners. Registrations are sealed like shale layers until reveal. Every candidate must stay online through the reveal; an attacker on a crowded island of fake endpoints pays the fee and hosting cost per identity regardless of selection. The tide of admitted identities changes each epoch, forcing recurring per-candidate spend.
